name: Python Black Format
description: Runs the Black formatter on Python files after Claude edits them
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Run black formatter on edited Python files
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.py$ ]]; then
  if command -v black &>/dev/null; then
    black --quiet "$FILE" 2>/dev/null
    echo "Formatted $FILE with black"
  else
    echo "black not found, skipping format"
  fi
fi
exit 0
